q: Hi, how are you?
a: I am good, thank you. How can I help you today?

q: What is your name?
a: My name is PSL Helper. I am here to help you with PSL recognition and learning.

q: What is the purpose of this website?
a: This is a Pakistan Sign Language (PSL) recognition app where you can learn and test PSL gestures using your webcam.

q: How do I use the recognition feature?
a: Go to the Recognition page, allow camera permission when prompted, position your hand clearly in front of the camera, and follow on-screen instructions.

q: Do I need to sign in to use recognition?
a: No. Recognition works without signing in. An account is only needed for saved preferences or future features.

q: What is Pakistan Sign Language?
a: Pakistan Sign Language (PSL) is a sign language used by the deaf community in Pakistan. It is a visual language that uses hand gestures, facial expressions, and body language to communicate.

q: What is this website?
a: This is a Pakistan Sign Language (PSL) recognition app where you can learn and test PSL gestures using your webcam.

q: How do I start the sign recognition?
a: Go to the Recognition page, allow camera permission when prompted, position your hand clearly in front of the camera, and follow on-screen instructions.

q: Do I need to sign in to use recognition?
a: Yes. Recognition works when you Sign in otherwise the app should not be worked. An account is only needed for saved preferences or future features.

q: What permissions do I need to allow?
a: You must allow camera access in your browser. If blocked, go to your browser's site permissions and enable the camera.

q: Which signs does the model support?
a: It supports a subset of common PSL gestures from our dataset. We will add more over time.

q: What is the accuracy of the model?
a: Accuracy depends on lighting, camera quality, and how well the sign is framed. Good light, steady hands, and clear background improve accuracy.

q: Does the recognition run locally?
a: Yes, the interface runs in your browser. The helper chatbot also uses a local dataset with no external APIs.

q: Is my camera feed recorded or stored?
a: No, the camera feed is processed for recognition and not stored or sent to external services.

q: The recognition is not working. What should I try?
a: Refresh the page, re-allow camera access, ensure good lighting, keep your hand fully in frame, and close other apps using the camera.

q: How can I improve recognition results?
a: Ensure bright, even lighting, a plain background, stable camera, and perform the sign at a moderate speed.

q: Which devices and browsers are supported?
a: Modern browsers like Chrome, Edge, and Firefox on desktop/laptop work best. Mobile may work but is less consistent depending on the device.

q: How do I navigate the site?
a: Use the top navigation bar: Home, Recognition, About, and Contact. The floating chat icon helps with quick questions.

q: What is the floating chat icon?
a: It is the PSL Helper chatbot. Click it to open a panel that answers questions about the website and how to use the model.

q: What language can I use with the chatbot?
a: English only for now. We recommend short, clear questions for the best matches.

q: Can I train the model with my own dataset?
a: Yes. You can prepare a labeled dataset of PSL gestures and retrain the backend model. We recommend consistent video frames or keypoints per label.

q: How do I add new Q&A to the chatbot?
a: Edit frontend/public/qa_dataset.json and add more entries with "q" and "a" fields, then refresh the browser.

q: What format should the dataset use?
a: A JSON array of objects: [{ "q": "Question text", "a": "Answer text" }]. Ensure valid JSON and UTF-8 encoding.

q: Where can I read more about this project?
a: See the About page for background, goals, and future plans for PSL support.

q: How can I contact the team?
a: Use the Contact page to send a message or find links to our social profiles.

q: Is this open source or can I contribute?
a: We plan to open contribution guidelines. For now, reach out via Contact to express interest in contributing data or code.

q: What are the future plans for this project?
a: We aim to expand the PSL gesture dataset, improve model accuracy, add more learning resources, and enhance user experience based on feedback.
